ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTDECLARATION THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT DECLARATION ("ZLDDec")is made as of the 2 day of Novsu , 2021 by 2647 REALTY LLC having an address at 5314 16th Avenue, #300, Brooklyn, NY 11204 (the “Declarant"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Declarant (in its capacity as the owner of Lower Parcel, as defined below, “Lower Parcel Owner") is the fee owner of the land located below the Lower Limiting Plane, as defined below (the “Lower Parcel"), together with the building and improvements thereon (the “Lower Parcel Building"), located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as part of Lot 52 in Block 1872 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map") and as and by the street address 2674 Broadway, New York, NY 10025, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS,Declarant (in its capacity as the owner of Airspace Parcel, as defined below, the “Airspace Parcel Owner") is the owner of the airspace located above the Lower Limiting Plane, as defined below (the “Airspace Parcel"), known as tentative Lot 9052 on the Tax Map, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof; Statement (the “ZLDOS") dated September 9, 2021 and recorded in the City Register under CRFN 2021000372768, and in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term "zoning lot" in Section 12-10(c) of the Zoning Resolution, the Lower Parcel and the Airspace Parcel were declared to be a single zoning lot (the “Zoning Lot"). WHEREAS, there are“Excess Floor Area Development Rights”(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Lower Parcel that are available for allocation to the Airspace Parcel in accordance with the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Declarant wishes to set forth certain agreements with respect to the rights and obligations of the Lower Parcel Owner and the Airspace Parcel Owner, respectively, in and to the Excess Floor Area Development Rights; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, the Declarant hereby declares as follows: I. Certain Definitions.
